title: EEZ Settlement
description: Existing settlement policy and unresolved attempt observations; due, dispatched, included and canonical completion are distinct.

panels.title: Last evaluated policy
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Due means at least one policy trigger fired; it does not prove preparation, dispatch, inclusion or completion.

targets.expr: (reth_eez_composer_settlement_due{job="eez-composer-reth"} >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Pure-L2 interval countdown
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Conditional deadline only when pending pure-L2 activity exists in interval mode. Negative means the threshold time passed. Cross-chain, fullness and block rules may trigger earlier. This is not a guaranteed inclusion time.

targets.expr: ((reth_eez_composer_settlement_pure_interval_deadline_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"} > 0) - time()) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Policy evaluation age
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Age of the last successful policy evaluation. Unknown on failed, cancelled or obsolete evaluations.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_settlement_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Evaluated L1 target
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Exact target supplied to the evaluated policy. It may already have passed; it is not a prediction of the next successful post.

targets.expr: ((reth_eez_composer_settlement_target_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"} > 0) * 1000) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Canonical anchor age
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Age of the canonical L1 commitment used by policy. Before the first commitment advance, this is registration time. Only validated commitment changes reset the policy clock.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_settlement_anchor_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Last cross-chain completion age
panels.description: Age since the local observation of the last retained canonical cross-chain completion. Includes completion from any reconciled attempt. Unknown after restart or invalidating reorg; inactivity is not a failure. This is separate from commitment advancement and submission receipts.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_last_completion_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Pending blocks and general trigger
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Distance from anchor to evaluated candidate, including the candidate Sync block. The general trigger counts blocks, including empty history; it is not a wall-clock timer or packing limit.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_settlement_unsettled_blocks{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

reth_eez_composer_settlement_block_threshold{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Why policy is due
panels.description: Samples are observations, not a settlement audit trail. Policy observations are hidden after canonical-generation changes until another successful evaluation. Each active trigger is 1. Several may apply at once: general block threshold, pure always/interval, executable cross-chain work, blob fullness, retained drain or window limit. A fresh sample does not create a new evaluation.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_settlement_trigger{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Current unresolved submission (sampled)
panels.description: One active state for the lowest unresolved attempt. None means no unresolved attempt, not a successful settlement. Dispatched is recorded immediately before the network request. Included means a canonical receipt was observed; derivation still decides which effects applied. Excluded/uncertain remain unresolved until reconciliation. Short transitions may be missed. This is sampled pending state, not a history of all transitions. Use Submission events for outcomes that occur between samples.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Submission events since restart
panels.description: Recorded at the submission task, even if an outcome arrives after canonical reconciliation. Included is an L1 receipt, not confirmation of every cross-chain user. Retries are separate attempts. Counters reset on process restart.

panels.title: Latest submission event times
panels.description: Local wall-clock observation times. Prepared starts after batch proving; dispatched is immediately before the network request. Included is receipt-observation time, not the L1 block timestamp. Missing event types have not been observed since restart.

panels.title: Submission timings
panels.description: Latest monotonic elapsed duration for each stage. Prepared-to-dispatch includes waiting and final pricing, but excludes prior proving. Dispatch-to-included/excluded/uncertain ends when the submitter returns, not canonical user completion. Pre-dispatch failures have no dispatch duration.

panels.title: Submission exclusions since restart
panels.description: Excluded includes builder discard, auction loss or relay-side rejection; those causes cannot be distinguished here. Slot-skipped, target-changed and submission-window-missed are separate reasons. A failed attempt can later be retried successfully.

panels.title: Cross-chain requests in latest submitted Sync attempt
panels.description: Original signed inbound/outbound user requests selected for the latest prepared submission attempt. Excludes generated system/effect transactions. Anchor-only attempts record zero. A retry is a new attempt, not a new unique completed user. Idle Sync blocks without a submission do not update this panel. Exact block/count pairs are also recorded in the eez.composer.submission.sync_requests structured log; brief attempts can be missed by this last-value chart.

panels.title: Latest submitted Sync L2 block
panels.description: L2 endpoint of the latest prepared submission attempt; may be a historical empty boundary. Correlate with the request-count graph and structured logs. It is not evidence of successful settlement.

panels.title: Canonical cross-chain completion observations
panels.description: Confirmed user effects, recorded separately from submission receipt outcomes. Repeated sampling/reconciliation does not increase counts. Reobservations after an invalidating reorg count again; this is operational history, not a unique-user accounting ledger. Resets on restart.
